# Drug Channels Institute

> > Drug Channels Institute (DCI) provides authoritative pharmaceutical economics research, industry analysis, and education on drug distribution, pharmacy benefit managers (PBMs), and healthcare reimbursement channels.

Founded and led by Adam J. Fein, Ph.D., DCI publishes comprehensive economic reports on pharmacies, PBMs, pharmaceutical wholesalers, and specialty distributors. The institute offers professional e-learning modules and hosts the Drug Channels Leadership Forum, serving as a trusted resource for understanding how funds flow through the pharmaceutical supply chain.

## Key Topics

- Pharmaceutical Economics
- Pharmacy Benefit Managers (PBMs)
- Drug Distribution Channels
- Pharmaceutical Wholesalers
- Pharmacy Reimbursement
- Specialty Distributors
- Patient Affordability
- Healthcare Supply Chain
- Adam J. Fein
- Economic Reports on Pharmacies
- Drug Channels Blog
- Follow the Dollar Methodology
- Pharmacy Economics
- Industry Research and Analysis
